subject: POC kickoff — cross-team calendar pivot & success criteria
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alice Turner <alice.turner@greenbank.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff — proposed slots & success criteria

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for carving time with us. We’d like to lock the POC kickoff next week and make sure the right folks from your side are on the call (engineering, procurement, and security). Below is a short proposal so we can close on time/owners: 

Proposed 90-minute kickoff agenda (owners in parens):
- 0–10m: Introductions & goals (Laura)
- 10–30m: Architecture & integration touchpoints (Karthik SE + GreenBank eng)
- 30–50m: Data handling, retention & security obligations (Soojin + GreenBank security)
- 50–75m: POC success criteria & test plan (Laura + GreenBank PM)
- 75–90m: Next steps, timeline & procurement items (Jonas, procurement)

Candidate slots (PT):
- Tue 2026-04-20: 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Wed 2026-04-21: 09:00–10:30 or 15:00–16:30

Attached is a one-pager with proposed success criteria and a draft ownership matrix: "POC-success-criteria.xlsx". Also shared the folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xYz-POC-Docs-GB

Could you confirm who from engineering/security/procurement should join and which slot works best? If those windows don’t fit, let me know a couple of times and we’ll pivot.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | (415) 555-0126
[Attachment: POC-success-criteria.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@medsys.io>

Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 11:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — proposed slots & success criteria

Thanks Laura — appreciate the clear agenda. Alice and I took a quick look and we have two constraints to call out from our side:
1) Our lead infra engineer (Ravi) is heads-down Thu/Fri on a migration — he can only do Mon/Tue mornings.
2) Procurement wants to be part of the kickoff for the timeline & licenses discussion (they are copied: procurement@greenbank.com).

Of your proposed slots the Tue 10:00–11:30 PT looks best for us, but only if you can confirm an SE will lead the integration/infra section — otherwise we’ll need to shift to Wed 09:00 PT.

Can Karthik or Jonas cover the infra portion?

Thanks,
Carlos
Principal Systems Engineer | MedSys Integrations
carlos.mendez@medsys.io

Laura / team —

I can cover the infra/architecture portion for Tue 10:00 PT (happy to own the integration walkthrough + connectivity checklist). Quick FYI on our side: I’m blocked on Monday morning for an internal infra dry-run but Tue 10:00 PT is clear for me.

If GreenBank needs Wed morning we can also do Wed 09:00 PT but it means Soojin (security lead) will need to shift from 15:00 to 09:00 which she said she’d prefer not to do. So my preference is keep Tue 10:00 — it minimizes churn for both sides.

Also added a short list of items I’ll cover during the security/ops section so Soojin can add details:
- required firewall rules and ports (Karthik)
- KV/cache sizing and token retention assumptions (Karthik)
- data flow diagram + redaction expectations (Soojin)

If procurement needs a separate 20-minute slot immediately after the kickoff for contract questions, Jonas can take that and walk procurement through the MOA and billing timeline.

—Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks for the quick turn. Per Carlos’ note and Karthik’s availability we’ll schedule the kickoff for:
